posts.post:
a crisp white tee under a blazer is a uniform.
a hoodie under a blazer is just trying too hard.
the bar for how men dress in this country is so low that a clean fit makes you look like you're trying to win an award.

we spent six months finding a cotton heavy enough to actually hold a silhouette.
see if you can tell the difference at strayed.in
there's always one hoodie in the closet. the one you reach for when you're late, tired, or just need to get out the door.
